notes: A raw failure becomes a tool result the model can act on. Each catalogue entry says
what the model should do next and whether trying again could possibly help.
An unrecognised code gets a generic message and `retryable: false` — an error nobody
described is not one you can promise will clear.
`fields` names the arguments the model should change, and appears only when there are any.

order_not_found.instruction: No order with that id. Ask the customer to confirm the order number.

amount_over_limit.instruction: The credit exceeds the 5000 cent limit. Lower the amount or request approval.

upstream_timeout.instruction: The order service did not answer. Try the same call again.

result.message: No order with that id. Ask the customer to confirm the order number.
